# clumio_gcs_protection_group (Resource)

Clumio GCP Protection Group Resource used to create and manage GCS protection groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clumio_gcs_protection_group" "example" {
  name = "my-gcp-protection-group"

  bucket_rule {
    gcp_project_id {
      eq = "my-project"
    }
    gcp_label {
      # Single-label and match-all operators are maps of key => value.
      eq  = { team = "data" }
      all = { managed = "true", tier = "gold" }
      # in/not_in are repeated blocks so the same key can carry multiple values.
      in {
        key   = "env"
        value = "prod"
      }
      in {
        key   = "env"
        value = "staging"
      }
    }
  }

  include_prefixes    = ["data/"]
  latest_version_only = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The user-assigned name of the protection group.

### Optional

- `bucket_rule` (Block, Optional) Rule that automatically adds matching GCS buckets to the protection group. Within each condition field at most one include operator (eq/contains/in/all) and one exclude operator (not_eq/not_contains/not_in/not_all) may be set; the API rejects invalid combinations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--bucket_rule))
- `exclude_prefixes` (Set of String) A list of prefixes to exclude from the backup.
- `include_prefixes` (Set of String) A list of prefixes to include in the backup.
- `latest_version_only` (Boolean) Whether to back up only the latest object version. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `backup_status_stats` (Attributes) Aggregated backup status statistics for the protection group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_status_stats))
- `bucket_count` (Number) The total number of unique buckets in this protection group.
- `bucket_rule_matched_bucket_count` (Number) The number of buckets matched by the bucket rule.
- `bucket_rule_matched_bucket_uuids` (Set of String) The set of bucket UUIDs matched by the bucket rule.
- `bucket_uuids` (Set of String) The set of bucket UUIDs directly assigned to this protection group.
- `created_timestamp` (String) Creation time of the protection group in RFC-3339 format.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Clumio GCP protection group.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) The GCP labels associated with the protection group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `last_backup_timestamp` (String) Time of the last backup in RFC-3339 format.
- `location` (String) The location of the protection group.
- `location_type` (String) The location type of the protection group.
- `manual_added_bucket_count` (Number) The number of buckets manually assigned to this protection group.
- `modified_timestamp` (String) Modified time of the protection group in RFC-3339 format.
- `organizational_unit_id` (String) The Clumio-assigned ID of the organizational unit associated with the protection group.
- `protection_info` (Attributes List) The protection policy applied to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--protection_info))
- `protection_status` (String) The protection status of the protection group.
- `total_backed_up_object_count` (Number) The total number of objects backed up in this protection group.
- `total_backed_up_size_bytes` (Number) The total size in bytes backed up in this protection group.
- `version` (Number) Version of the protection group. Incremented on every change.

### Nested Schema for `bucket_rule`

Optional:

- `gcp_location` (Block, Optional) GCP location-based bucket conditions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--bucket_rule--gcp_location))

<a id="nestedblock--bucket_rule--gcp_label"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bucket_rule.gcp_label`

Optional:

- `all` (Map of String) Match buckets with all of these labels. Provide labels as {key = value, ...}.
- `contains` (Map of String) Match buckets containing this label. Provide a single label as {key = value}.
- `eq` (Map of String) Match buckets with this exact label. Provide a single label as {key = value}.
- `in` (Block Set) Match buckets with any of these labels. Repeat the block to allow multiple values for the same key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--bucket_rule--gcp_label--in))
- `not_all` (Map of String) Exclude buckets with all of these labels. Provide labels as {key = value, ...}.
- `not_contains` (Map of String) Exclude buckets containing this label. Provide a single label as {key = value}.
- `not_eq` (Map of String) Exclude buckets with this exact label. Provide a single label as {key = value}.
- `not_in` (Block Set) Exclude buckets with any of these labels. Repeat the block to exclude multiple values for the same key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--bucket_rule--gcp_label--not_in))
